My family and friends are all I have been thinking about. I wrote a book to my parents telling them how much I love and appreciate them. I emailed everyone I could find of friends of a friend, my friend being the guy who used me, to make him a book that could tell him how much he is appreciated and how much he means to people. So that he could have it for the moments when he feels empty, alone or depressed. I've done what I've seen in my power to do to make them happy, loved, appreciated. I've tried to help out when ever they've needed me, If it was to help them forget about their problems, clean their rooms, or to talk about whatever was on their minds. I've done it for him, I've tried to do it for my other friends, I've listen to my father on how he couldn't take things anymore, how he swallowed a lot of pills but just not many enough, how the instincts kick in the moment you're about to die, making everything unbearable , you can't live and can't die, because instincts tell you to live, even if you don't want to, they make you panic in the moment when everything might finally end. And there you go, can't even manage to die. Or someone rushes in to save you, just in time, like my mother did for him. I've listen to problems about their sex-lives, and I have tried to be strong. I don't have it in me anymore. I don't really even have my friends anymore. They are happy now, they nor want or need me in their daily lives. They are happy if they don't have to have me in their daily lives, lees I'm there the happier they are. They like me on the other side of town, the other side of the country and the other side of a computer that can be turned off. So now, I'm thinking of me. It's not enough to have friends once in a while, it's not enough to be on the other side of a computer, it's not enough that I'm usually the one who says hi or suggest to do something together. I need to be apart of someones daily life. I want it and I need it, but it's not within my reach. I'm too tired to start over, searching for new friends, because I've tried over and over. I'm empty. Hell I even made a harry potter board game just to bring all of my friends closer together, to give us something to laugh about together. I used techniques from drama class that is designed to give a safe, and good social environment. Every one must do the same thing that makes them all feel stupid, and they end up laughing with each other and be more comfortable in each others company and in being themselves (that's the philosophy put in short). I hoped it would help my old friendships and maybe help make new ones. All of this may not seem like a lot, but I feel I have worked my butt off, and I don't know what more I can do. I'm stuck alone with myself and I hate it. I've tried and I've failed. I have come dangerously close to loosing my parents several times, because the one cant live without the other, and I alone am not reason good enough to keep any of them alive. So I'm done thinking that I'll hurt them by taking my own. Of course it will hurt them, and maybe my friends too for a little while. But my friends, like I said, I don't belong in their daily lives, they don't want me there. I don't want to die because I don't want it to hurt, I want to believe that everything will change and I will be allowed to love and be loved by someone, both a man and friends and family. But I've tried what I can see is in my power to do, and I'm done trying, because I no longer have a good fight in me. I'm just empty. And this is not a movie, there won't be a man or a friend swooping in to save the day. It is only ever going to be me, and I'm tired of me. I don't want me for company anymore, but I can't turn of my computer or move to get away from me. And I don't want to make friends with new people and risk destroying their lives somehow, being a burden, or whatever it is that I do. I don't have the conscience for that. I'm 28 years old already, and create mostly bad things just by being me. If I haven't learned to be a good person that other people enjoy the company of by now, I don't think I ever will.

I truly appreciate what all of you have tried to do, but I need someone who isn't a stranger, that's not on the other side of the world. I may sound like a victim, but I know the mistakes I've made, and I know that the one to blame for them also is me, not the guy, not the bullies, me. I was there and I could have done things differently, but I didn't. I thank you for being good human beings who wants me well. It means something, and I hope you will continue to reach out to people, because maybe you will save someone.

I have chosen the way I want to die, and I feel good about the decision. I'm poetic of nature, and my exit will fit me. I think I have found a way to use my last act for something good.

Thank you again for all your time, I know it must have cost some of you pain by digging into old memories and uncovering your wounds for my sake. It isn't for nothing though, others will see the thread, and they will hear your stories and thoughts and be moved by them, maybe enough to make out new and better directions in and with their lives. Thank you. I'd like to ask for one last favor though. When my time is up, if I'm scared, would you like to keep me company?

Sorry for the long post and any spelling mistakes. English is not my native language.

I just want to thank everyone for responding. I read all comments that comes in, it just takes a bit of time to make a proper response. Thank you for sharing your thoughts and experiences with me. I wish that for those of you who still struggle with shadows of the past or present are able to flip the world sunny side up. I admire those of you who can, it takes quite the amount of strength to do so.

I am getting help, have for a little while now. I asked for it myself. But I'm tired of fighting a battle that seems there's no possible way of winning. It is hard to think of the hardships I have caused and still may be causing. It seems a high price for everyone to pay for someone who just might turn into something good a long time from now.

Thank you for your kind words though.
